audit_items.proof_trace: All four public liquidation entry points (liquidate, liquidate_as_coin, liquidate_adl_borrow, liquidate_adl_deposit) call pre_liquidation_check, which calls ensure_has_permission performing a dual check: (1) the cap ID must exist in the whitelist VecMap, and (2) the liquidation permission bit (1u32 << 2 = 4) must be set in the stored bitmask. PackageCallerCap creation is gated behind public(package) mint_cap and the sole public constructor mint_new_whitelist requires AdminCap; permission grants via update_permission also require AdminCap, so no external actor can create or elevate a cap.
